title: Resolution declaring August as Black Pride Month in NYC
summary: The resolution declares the month of August as Black Pride Month in New York City, honoring the NYC Black Pride movement founded in 1997 that uplifts the Black LGBTQIA+ community. It recognizes organizations like the NYC Center for Black Pride, which now hosts an annual five-day festival, running August 19-23, 2026, that draws visitors from around the world.
